summary: Iteration 9 - Kitchen DnD fix validation (frontend only). Tested kitchen screen load, tutorial flow, bubble positioning, soup fly animation, info panel, and multi-viewport layout. Gesture interaction (tap/drag) could not be verified via Playwright due to RNGH web gesture system not responding to simulated Playwright events.

react_native_issues.issue: RNGH Tap/Pan gestures on Expo web preview cannot be tested via Playwright mouse/touch simulation — gestures use internal RNGH event dispatcher. Tap-to-show-info-panel and drag-to-slot behaviors unverifiable via automated browser testing. Requires manual native device or Expo Go testing.

action_items: Manually verify on device: tap soup → info panel shows 'Herb Soup' + 'Restores 20 Stamina.' with no dark overlay
Manually verify drag offset fix: item stays at pickup position, no jump to finger
Manually verify 10 consecutive drag cycles with no sticking
Manually verify drag to player portrait → consume → stamina increase
Manually verify drag to Rupert → rejection bubble
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ dragOffsetX/dragOffsetY correctly computed as (itemCenterX - absX) in onDragBegin, applied in onUpdate — touch offset bug fixed
✅ cancelAnimation() called for all 4 shared values in onDragBegin — prevents stale animation callbacks
✅ returnDragToSlot has 'if (!done) return' guard — prevents state corruption when new drag cancels return animation
✅ onFinalize added to panGesture — gesture cancel/error cleanup properly handled
✅ dropHandledRef prevents double cleanup between onEnd and onFinalize
✅ soupFlySize derived from measured slot width (w * 0.80) — matches in-slot soupSlotTouch size (80% of slot)
✅ Info panel uses infoPanel/infoPanelCard styles — compact, non-modal, no dark overlay, above locationBar
✅ Bubble top = rupertL.y + rupertL.h + 8 — correctly positioned 8px below portrait bottom (measured: portrait bottom=200, bubble top=208)

success_rate.frontend: 75% (visual/layout tests pass; gesture interaction untestable via Playwright)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Kitchen screen loads correctly. Tutorial flow works: intro bubble → soup flies to slot 0 → inspect bubble → SOUP_ON_TABLE state. Bubble appears 8px below portrait row (correct). Info panel is compact/non-modal. All DnD code fixes are structurally correct per code review. Gesture testing requires native device/Expo Go — Playwright cannot simulate RNGH touch/pan events on web preview.
rca_of_issue: RNGH Gesture Handler on Expo web preview uses internal pointer capture and does not respond to Playwright's simulated mouse/touch events. This is a Playwright + RNGH web compatibility limitation, not an app bug.
